announcement.title: 0.4.18-b3 — required update (VRChat API change)
announcement.message:
0.4.18-b3 is a required update. VRChat changed its API, and earlier builds no longer track it cleanly — updating keeps VRChat and moderation features working correctly. Aside from that change, this build matches 0.4.18-b2.

Separately: there has been interest in a locally-hosted web UI for administering Scarlet. Because that would involve credential storage and administrator access, I want it done properly rather than improvised or AI-generated — I'm looking for someone with genuine application-security experience to help design and build it. If that's you and you'd like to contribute, please reach out in the Discord.
